follow-up time: Not specified, but long enough for subsequent pregnancy and delivery in a subset of patients
cohort: Patients with high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HSIL) treated at 11 obstetrics and gynecology hospitals between January 1, 2013, and December 31, 2015.
finding: LEEP was associated with an increased risk of preterm birth, and pain during sexual intercourse increased with greater cone depth and volume.
